sloka: केशान् कर्णललाटांश्च नासिकाश्च प्लवङ्गमाः।रक्षसां दशनैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नखैश्चापि न्यकर्तयन् ।। ६.९४.१४ ।।
transliteration: keśān karṇalalāṭāṁśca nāsikāśca plavaṅgamāḥ।rakṣasāṁ daśanaistīkṣṇairnakhaiścāpi nyakartayan ।। 6.94.14 ।।

translations.english: The monkeys with their sharp teeth and nails tore off the hair, ears, noses, and forehead of the Rakshasas,
